summary.id: Memimpin seluruh kegiatan operasional harian gedung, menjaga komunikasi dengan pemilik atau pengurus PPPSRS, mengelola anggaran OPEX, serta memastikan pencapaian standar layanan.
summary.en: Leads day-to-day building operations, keeps open communication with owners or the PPPSRS board, manages the OPEX budget, and makes sure service standards are met.

id: Memimpin koordinasi seluruh departemen operasional gedung (Engineering, Housekeeping, Security, Tenant Relations)
Menyusun dan mengawasi implementasi Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) dan House Rules gedung
Mengendalikan realisasi anggaran biaya operasional (OPEX) agar efisien dan sesuai target anggaran tahunan
Menjalin kemitraan strategis dan komunikasi berkala dengan pemilik gedung atau perwakilan PPPSRS
Menangani eskalasi keluhan tenant atau insiden operasional secara cepat dan solutif
Memastikan kepatuhan gedung terhadap seluruh regulasi pemerintah (SLF, K3, Amdal, Asuransi Gedung)
en: Lead coordination across all building operations teams (Engineering, Housekeeping, Security, Tenant Relations)
Develop and oversee implementation of the building SOPs and house rules
Control actual operating expenses (OPEX) against the approved annual budget
Maintain a strategic working relationship and regular communication with the building owner or PPPSRS representatives
Resolve tenant complaints and operational incidents quickly and constructively
Ensure the building complies with all government regulations (SLF, occupational health and safety, environmental permits, building insurance)

id: Pendidikan minimal S1 Teknik Sipil / Arsitektur / Manajemen / Perhotelan
Pengalaman minimal 5 tahun sebagai Building Manager di high-rise building (Office Tower / Luxury Apartment)
Memiliki sertifikasi Certified Building Manager atau sertifikasi profesi manajemen properti (nilai tambah)
Memahami sistem mekanikal-elektrikal gedung (HVAC, Lift, Fire Protection, STP/WTP) dan regulasi SLF
Memiliki kemampuan leadership, negosiasi, dan interpersonal yang sangat kuat
Terbiasa menggunakan sistem manajemen digital operasional properti
en: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Management, or Hospitality
At least 5 years as a Building Manager in a high-rise building (office tower or luxury apartment)
Certified Building Manager or another property management professional certification (an advantage)
Working knowledge of building mechanical and electrical systems (HVAC, elevators, fire protection, STP/WTP) and SLF regulations
Strong leadership, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
Comfortable using digital property operations systems

summary.id: Mengelola perencanaan dan pelaksanaan perawatan preventif sistem mekanikal, elektrikal, HVAC, lift, genset, serta instalasi pengolahan air gedung.
summary.en: Plans and carries out preventive maintenance of mechanical, electrical, HVAC, elevator, generator, and water treatment systems.

id: Menyusun jadwal dan checklist Preventive Maintenance (PM) untuk seluruh sistem M&E gedung
Memimpin tim teknisi shift dalam pemeliharaan harian, pengoperasian Chiller/HVAC, Trafo, dan Genset
Melakukan monitoring dan audit konsumsi daya listrik serta air gedung untuk program konservasi energi
Mengawasi kelayakan dan pengujian berkala sistem proteksi kebakaran (Hydrant, Sprinkler, Fire Alarm)
Mengkoordinasikan penanganan trouble ticketing dan perbaikan gangguan teknis tenant dengan SLA cepat
Mendampingi proses riksa uji berkala Disnaker dan perpanjangan sertifikasi laik fungsi instalasi teknik
en: Prepare preventive maintenance (PM) schedules and checklists for all building M&E systems
Lead the shift technician team in daily maintenance and operation of chillers/HVAC, transformers, and generators
Monitor and audit building power and water consumption for the energy conservation program
Oversee periodic readiness testing of fire protection systems (hydrants, sprinklers, fire alarms)
Coordinate trouble tickets and tenant technical repairs within fast SLAs
Support the periodic inspections by the labor ministry office (Disnaker) and the renewal of technical installation certificates

id: Pendidikan minimal D3 / S1 Teknik Elektro / Mesin
Pengalaman minimal 4 tahun di bidang engineering gedung bertingkat (Office / Mall / Apartemen)
Memahami prinsip kerja sistem Chiller Water Cooled, AHU/FCU, Panel MV/LV, Transformer, dan STP/WTP
Memiliki Surat Ijin Kelaikan (SIO) atau sertifikasi K3 Listrik / Mekanikal (nilai plus)
Mampu membaca gambar teknis / As-Built Drawing dan skematik instalasi listrik
Disiplin, teliti, dan siap siaga dalam penanganan kondisi darurat operasional
en: Diploma (D3) or bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering
At least 4 years in engineering for multi-story buildings (office, mall, or apartment)
Understanding of water-cooled chillers, AHU/FCU, MV/LV panels, transformers, and STP/WTP
Operator license (SIO) or electrical/mechanical occupational health and safety certification (a plus)
Able to read technical drawings, as-built drawings, and electrical schematics
Disciplined, meticulous, and ready to respond in operational emergencies

summary.id: Menangani komunikasi harian dengan penyewa dan penghuni, mengoordinasikan tindak lanjut permintaan layanan melalui sistem manajemen gedung, serta mengawasi administrasi fit-out.
summary.en: Handles daily communication with tenants and residents, coordinates follow-up on service requests through the building management system, and oversees fit-out administration.

id: Menjadi titik kontak utama (single point of contact) bagi tenant perkantoran maupun penghuni gedung
Menerima, mencatat, dan mengoordinasikan penanganan tiket keluhan / permintaan layanan melalui sistem operasional gedung
Mengawasi permohonan izin kerja (Work Permit), pengangkutan barang (Move-in / Move-out), dan renovasi fit-out
Menjalankan survei kepuasan tenant secara berkala dan menganalisis masukan untuk perbaikan layanan
Mengelola informasi dan pengumuman gedung kepada seluruh penyewa secara profesional
en: Act as the single point of contact for office tenants and building residents
Receive, log, and coordinate handling of complaint and service request tickets through the building operations system
Oversee work permit applications, move-in and move-out logistics, and fit-out renovations
Run regular tenant satisfaction surveys and analyze feedback to improve service
Share building information and announcements with all tenants professionally

id: Pendidikan minimal D3 / S1 Komunikasi / Hubungan Masyarakat / Perhotelan / Manajemen
Pengalaman minimal 2 tahun di bidang Tenant Relations, Customer Service, atau Hospitality di properti
Kemampuan komunikasi verbal dan tertulis yang prima dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan Bahasa Inggris
Sikap ramah, berorientasi pada solusi, dan memiliki ketahanan stres yang baik
Terbiasa mengoperasikan software ticketing operasional dan Microsoft Office
en: Diploma (D3) or bachelor’s degree in Communication, Public Relations, Hospitality, or Management
At least 2 years in tenant relations, customer service, or property hospitality
Excellent spoken and written communication in Indonesian and English
Friendly, solution-oriented, and resilient under pressure
Comfortable using operational ticketing software and Microsoft Office

summary.id: Mengelola administrasi penagihan Service Charge/IPL, rekonsiliasi utilitas, pengendalian anggaran operasional, serta penyusunan laporan keuangan berkala.
summary.en: Manages service charge and IPL billing, utility reconciliation, operating budget control, and periodic financial reporting.

id: Mengelola siklus penagihan rutin Service Charge, IPL, Sinking Fund, serta tagihan listrik & air tenant
Melakukan rekonsiliasi bank dan pencatatan kas masuk / kas keluar operasional harian gedung
Memonitor realisasi pengeluaran kas terhadap anggaran OPEX bulanan yang disetujui
Menyusun laporan keuangan bulanan (Neraca, Laba Rugi, Arus Kas) untuk manajemen dan pemilik aset/PPPSRS
Mengawasi penagihan piutang tertunggak (Aging AR) dan melakukan koordinasi penagihan persuasif
en: Manage the regular billing cycle for service charge, IPL, sinking fund, and tenant electricity and water
Perform bank reconciliation and record the building’s daily operating cash receipts and disbursements
Monitor cash spending against the approved monthly OPEX budget
Prepare monthly financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, cash flow) for management and asset owners or the PPPSRS
Oversee overdue receivables (AR aging) and coordinate courteous collection follow-up

id: Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi / Keuangan
Pengalaman minimal 3 tahun di bidang akuntansi properti, building management, atau perhotelan
Memahami perpajakan properti (PPN, PPh 4 ayat 2, PPh 23, PPh 21)
Mahir menggunakan spreadsheet (Excel) lanjutan dan software akuntansi / ERP properti
Jujur, teliti dengan angka, dan memiliki integritas tinggi
en: Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance
At least 3 years in property accounting, building management, or hospitality
Knowledge of property taxation (VAT, Article 4(2), Article 23, and Article 21 income tax)
Advanced spreadsheet skills and experience with accounting or property ERP software
Honest, careful with numbers, and of high integrity

experience.en: Certified General Occupational Health and Safety Expert (Ahli K3 Umum)

summary.id: Mengawasi penerapan prosedur keselamatan kerja gedung, pemeriksaan berkala alat proteksi kebakaran, serta pelaksanaan pelatihan tanggap darurat.
summary.en: Oversees workplace safety procedures, periodic checks of fire protection equipment, and emergency response training.

id: Mengawasi kepatuhan standar K3 (Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja) bagi seluruh pekerja gedung dan kontraktor
Melakukan inspeksi berkala terhadap sistem proteksi kebakaran (APAR, Hydrant, Sprinkler, Smoke Detector, Fire Door)
Menyusun Hazard Identification Risk Assessment and Determining Control (HIRADC) untuk operasional gedung
Menyelenggarakan pelatihan K3 dan simulasi evakuasi kebakaran / gempa secara berkala bagi penghuni gedung
Mengelola investigasi kecelakaan kerja dan penyusunan laporan kepatuhan K3 ke instansi terkait
en: Oversee compliance with occupational health and safety (K3) standards for all building staff and contractors
Carry out periodic inspections of fire protection systems (extinguishers, hydrants, sprinklers, smoke detectors, fire doors)
Prepare the Hazard Identification, Risk Assessment and Determining Control (HIRADC) for building operations
Run regular occupational health and safety training and fire and earthquake evacuation drills for building occupants
Manage workplace accident investigations and prepare occupational health and safety compliance reports for the relevant authorities

id: Pendidikan minimal D3 / S1 K3 / Kesehatan Masyarakat / Teknik Lingkungan
Memiliki sertifikat kompetensi Ahli K3 Umum aktif dari Kemnaker RI
Pengalaman minimal 2 tahun sebagai HSE Officer di high-rise building atau konstruksi
Memahami manajemen tanggap darurat dan regulasi proteksi kebakaran (NFPA / Permenaker)
Memiliki ketegasan dalam penegakan kepatuhan keselamatan kerja
en: Diploma (D3) or bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Public Health, or Environmental Engineering
Active General Occupational Health and Safety Expert (Ahli K3 Umum) competency certificate from the Ministry of Manpower
At least 2 years as an HSE officer in a high-rise building or construction
Knowledge of emergency response management and fire protection regulations (NFPA and Ministry of Manpower rules)
Firm in enforcing workplace safety compliance
